sampling.prediction_rule: One uniformly sampled unmatched eligible edge from the assigned model; no replacement if the pool is empty.
sampling.gold_rule: All gold edges in sampled clips; no duration filtering.
sampling.alignment: Original full-graph alignment and strict-greater tie-breaking; dangling prediction endpoints excluded as in scorer.

correct_rule: Media-supported endpoints, relation and direction, consistent with the displayed edge rule.
aggregation: Retain every submitted judgment; accept an edge only if all its two or three judgments are correct. Uncertain remains in the denominator.
participants: Eight non-author student volunteers at the authors university, with no research collaboration with the authors; none annotated gold or saw original prefills. All consented and were unpaid.
blinding: Gold/model provenance and other answers hidden; no default answer or target acceptance rate.
collection: An initial paired assignment was followed by three additional raters covering the same fixed tasks; the third judgment was not conditional on disagreement. Seven volunteers submitted 45 answers each; one submitted 15; all 330 are retained.
privacy: Participant names, enrollment tokens, timestamps and revision histories are excluded. Public participant IDs are arbitrary and carry no identity information.
